name: github-repo-analyzer
description: Analyze GitHub repositories for health, tech stack conformance, structured issue reviews with CWE/OWASP/NIST security classification, HITL code fix suggestions with embedded security reference catalog, and closure verification audits that detect unfixed issues marked as resolved. Runs a graphify knowledge graph as the mandatory first step of deep analysis — corpus built from the clone, runner protocol delegated to the standalone graphify plugin's graphify-core skill (team OpenRouter key, sandbox-safe two-pass split), with keyless code-only and plain-tree-walk fallbacks — to ground architecture and technical-debt findings. Built for MoxyWolf LLC internal use.
